name: smoothmyvideo
description: Desktop GUI for AI video frame interpolation (GMFSS), native TensorRT engine under the hood
author: Florin Nutiu

scripts.start: tsc && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning scripts/build-renderer.ts && electron .
scripts.setup: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.rmSync('node_modules', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.rmSync('package-lock.json', { force: true }); fs.rmSync('engine/bin', { recursive: true, force: true })" && npm install && node scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.ts && node scripts/stage-gpu-runtime.ts && node scripts/export-onnx.ts && npm start
scripts.dist: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('release', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning scripts/build-renderer.ts && node scripts/stage-gpu-runtime.ts --required && node scripts/export-onnx.ts --required && electron-builder && node scripts/pack-zip.ts
scripts.lint: prettier --write "src/**/*.ts" "scripts/*.ts" && tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && pyright && node scripts/clang-format.ts
